rationale: The Conditional Access export targets administrator roles on the Windows platform for all resources and requires the compliantDevice grant, so a sign-in or token request from an unmanaged Windows device would not satisfy the policy if it were enabled and matched.
limitation: Supporting hardening only: the export is disabled, scoped to administrator roles, has excluded groups, and only matches the Windows device platform, which is derived from client-reported information.
